data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ayn' (eye), Aysheen is a spiritual and revered name in Islamic culture. It is believed to signify the Eye of Moses, a symbol of guidance and divine intervention. The name Aysheen carries the meaning “Eye of Moses” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aysheen usually hope their child will grow to embody eye of moses and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Aysheen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Eye of Moses.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aysheen total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
